name: COLD official test split
independence: Collected and labeled by external dataset authors. No COLD train/dev data or test outcomes used to author or tune moderation-v1. No claim of independent human review by M1/M3.
sampling: Full test split, preserving order, duplicate rows and original labels. Exclude only blank text or text longer than the existing 2000-character request limit; count every exclusion.
purpose: External diagnostic. Its broad offensiveness labels do not equal the project's literal HIGH blocking policy; report both HIGH blocking and any-level candidate metrics.
privacy: Download raw CSV only to ignored qa-private/. Do not commit or log comment texts, identities or upstream row IDs. Publish aggregate counts and hashes only.
